# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (child)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome, middle-aged man with a strong, sad face that is splendidly modeled about the chin and brow. He has deep-set, dark blue eyes and iron-gray hair.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung and sensitive individual who maintains a reserved demeanor. Behind his proud nature lies a deep and tender character that he carefully hides from the world.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Twenty-five years after parting in anger from his former fiancee [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Stephen Irving returned and sent her a message through [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered the note to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and greeted Stephen upon his arrival, ushering him inside to reunite with [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). After reconciling with [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) during a walk in her garden, Stephen married her in an intimate garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the couple departed by train.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), +7 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 2**

- became engaged to Lavendar Lewis twenty-five years prior  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017)</sub>
- married a American woman who died two years prior  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>

## Quotes

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen Irving and [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were engaged when they were young, but their original romance ended following a quarrel [R1, S1]. Years later, Stephen sent a message to [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) through [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading to a visit at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) where the pair successfully reconciled [S2, S3]. The two subsequently married in a honeysuckle arbor during an intimate garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together [R2, S4].

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), +16 more_

- presumed Romantically involved with — formerly engaged when young  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), +1 more</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--stephen-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is Stephen Irving's son [R3]. Stephen reunited with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) at their home after returning from a trip, where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited them after school [S5].

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), +5 more_
